reanalyze.title: Analyze again
reanalyze.hint: Only if you changed the lyrics or the MP3. This redoes the shots: photos move to the new shots at the same moment and undo history is cleared (≈ 2 min).

analyze.title: Analyze the song
analyze.hint: Detects the beat and the parts, syncs the lyrics and understands them to find photos (≈ 2 min).

structure.title: Structure
structure.hint: the app uses it to pick pace and transitions

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.pasteHint: Paste the lyrics, each line on its own row. Suno tags like [Chorus] mark the parts of the song.
lyrics.reanalyzeHint: If you change them, analyze again so they get synced.
lyrics.syncedHint: Each line with its moment, how it's read and which photo would illustrate it.
lyrics.subHint: Tap the subtitle icon to show the line written in the video.

confirm.title: Change the song?
confirm.body: It will need to be analyzed again. Chosen photos (and pinned ones) move to the new shots at the same moment; undo history is lost.

file.formats: MP3 from Suno or elsewhere (WAV, M4A, OGG and FLAC work too)

language.label: Sung in
language.hint: Used to read the lyrics: syncing them, understanding each line and the words to look for in the photos.
language.hintAnalyzed: If you change it, analyze the song again so it applies.
